verdict.rationale: Azure exposes a well-documented public REST API with client libraries, unattended/script-friendly auth via Entra ID, and a full-featured CLI with scriptable/query output (JMESPath), all of which let an AI-native agent drive the platform programmatically; an official MCP server further extends agent integration. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (llms.txt/openapi.json returned 404 in probes) and independent hands-on confirmation of automated API-driven workflows beyond docs.
